The projects you work on range from smaller assignments to projects worth several million euros. - During the proposal phase of projects, you will provide the necessary technical information regarding Control, Electrical, and Instrumentation so that your colleagues in Sales can prepare a solid proposal. During the sales phase of projects, you will be able to draw simplified P&IDs yourself. - Sometimes you will work from existing specifications, but in many cases, you will discuss these directly with the client. - Subsequently, you will develop P&IDs, Control, Electrical & Instrumentation packages, and DCS/PLC functional diagrams. - You are responsible for specifying instrumentation, control valves, electrical components, cabling, lighting, MCC, BMS, burner installations, and DCS systems, as well as the associated engineering package. - You are responsible for properly supervising suppliers of instrumentation and components, including panel builders. - Ultimately, you are responsible for the technical evaluation of the bid and the associated documentation from subcontractors. - Finally, you may also be asked to assist with testing the delivered installation on-site. Requirements - You have a higher vocational education (HBO) level of work and thinking, supplemented by specialized training. - You have knowledge of measurement and control technology and a good command of Dutch and English. - You have sufficient knowledge of MS Office and AutoCAD.
